translationRepairs: Again, in the seating chart for the banquet of the first year of Xiangfu, Chief Counselor Wang Dan and Commissioner Shi Baoji sat on the east; the Prince of Ning, Yuanwei, the Prince of Shu, Yuanzheng, the Prince of Guangling Commandery, Yuanyan, and Military Commissioner Weiji sat on the west, each in separate ranks.

Again, in the seating chart for the banquet of the first year of Xiangfu, Chief Counselor Wang Dan and Commissioner Shi Baoji sat on the east; the Prince of Ning, Yuanwei, the Prince of Shu, Yuancheng, the Prince of Guangling Commandery, Yuanyan, and Military Commissioner Weiji sat on the west, each in separate ranks.
舒王元偁 uses 偁 (chēng); Yuancheng matches the graph, while Yuanzheng invents a wrong given-name reading.

Again, in the seating chart for the banquet of the first year of Xiangfu, Chief Counselor Wang Dan and Commissioner Shi Baoji were on the east; Prince of Ning Yuanwei, Prince of Shu Yuanzheng, Prince of Guangling Commandery Yuanyan, and Military Commissioner Weiji were on the west, seated in separate ranks.

Again, in the seating chart for the banquet of the first year of Xiangfu, Chief Counselor Wang Dan and Commissioner Shi Baoji were on the east; Prince of Ning Yuanwei, Prince of Shu Yuancheng, Prince of Guangling Commandery Yuanyan, and Military Commissioner Weiji were on the west, seated in separate ranks.
The literal likewise misreads 元偁 as Yuanzheng; Yuancheng is the correct romanization of 偁.

In the intercalary third month of the fourth year, the Court of Imperial Sacrifices and the Gate Office reported: "Pursuant to an edict to examine jointly the gate regulations submitted by Gate Commissioner Li Duankai, when chief counselors and imperial princes form ranks and take their seats, each side has its own head of rank; chief counselors and commissioners of military affairs who hold the commissioner rank, or who hold both a commandery prince title and commissioner rank in one row, together constitute the Central Secretariat and Gate Office rank.

In the intercalary third month of the fourth year, the Court of Imperial Sacrifices and the Gate Office reported: "Pursuant to an edict to examine jointly the gate regulations submitted by Gate Commissioner Li Duanque, when chief counselors and imperial princes form ranks and take their seats, each side has its own head of rank; chief counselors and commissioners of military affairs who hold the commissioner rank, or who hold both a commandery prince title and commissioner rank in one row, together constitute the Central Secretariat and Gate Office rank.
閣門使李端愨 has 愨 (què); Duanque is correct, and Duankai is a mistranscription of the given name.

In the intercalary third month of the fourth year, the Court of Imperial Sacrifices and the Gate Office reported: "Pursuant to the edict jointly to examine and fix the gate regulations submitted by Gate Commissioner Li Duankai, when chief counselors and imperial princes form ranks and take their seats, left and right each have a head of rank; chief counselors and Commissioners of Military Affairs who hold the commissioner rank, or who hold both a commandery prince and commissioner rank together in one row, are altogether the rank of the Central Secretariat and Gate Office.

In the intercalary third month of the fourth year, the Court of Imperial Sacrifices and the Gate Office reported: "Pursuant to the edict jointly to examine and fix the gate regulations submitted by Gate Commissioner Li Duanque, when chief counselors and imperial princes form ranks and take their seats, left and right each have a head of rank; chief counselors and Commissioners of Military Affairs who hold the commissioner rank, or who hold both a commandery prince and commissioner rank together in one row, are altogether the rank of the Central Secretariat and Gate Office.
The literal repeats Li Duankai for 李端愨; replacing with Li Duanque restores the correct reading of 愨.

In the Yuanyou era, Chief Counselor Lü Dagong said: "Yesterday, during regency behind the curtain, only remonstrance and censor officials were permitted to report two together, so improper words could not enter.

In the Yuanyou era, Chief Counselor Lü Dafang said: "Yesterday, during regency behind the curtain, only remonstrance and censor officials were permitted to report two together, so improper words could not enter.
宰臣呂大防 is Lü Dafang (防 fáng); Dagong invents a wrong second character reading.

In the Yuanyou era, Chief Counselor Lü Dagong said: "Yesterday, during regency behind the curtain, only the remonstrance and censor officials were permitted to report two together, so improper words could not enter.

In the Yuanyou era, Chief Counselor Lü Dafang said: "Yesterday, during regency behind the curtain, only the remonstrance and censor officials were permitted to report two together, so improper words could not enter.
The literal likewise has Lü Dagong for 呂大防; Lü Dafang matches 防.

It is fitting to order the Ministry of Personnel to assemble officials of the central platform, Hanlin, Secretariat, director of education, doctors of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices, and others to fix in detail the ritual for inner and outer officials meeting one another."

It is fitting to order the Department of State Affairs to assemble officials of the central platform, Hanlin, Secretariat, director of education, doctors of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices, and others to fix in detail the ritual for inner and outer officials meeting one another."
宜令尚書省 names the Department of State Affairs; Ministry of Personnel would be 吏部, so the original office translation is wrong.

It is fitting to order the Ministry of Personnel to assemble officials of the central platform, Hanlin, Secretariat, Director of Education, Doctors of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices, and others to fix in detail the ritual for inner and outer officials meeting one another."

It is fitting to order the Department of State Affairs to assemble officials of the central platform, Hanlin, Secretariat, Director of Education, Doctors of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices, and others to fix in detail the ritual for inner and outer officials meeting one another."
The literal has the same error: 尚書省 is Department of State Affairs, not Ministry of Personnel.
